text:
Marta: Quick preflight for the token-cost attribution rollforward — planning to flip the new joiner on prod tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need a quick ownership + deps check before I schedule.

Alex: Ack, I can do the canary dashboard. Need the sample queries and the expected metrics (tokens / cost / P95 latency).

Zhou: I can own the event schema migration (event.ingest.token.*). PR: https://repo/ci/pr/452 is open — needs review + approval for shard-safe fields.

Sara: FYI staging run showed ~15% P95 increase when prefix cache was enabled with current model mix. Saved tokens but latency shifted. I'll run a smaller smoke with the exact canary dataset.

Kevin: Ops note: gpu-pool-2 predicted utilization at 76% now, projection hits ~95% during peak if traffic continues. Can we do a small capacity bump or stagger canary?

ops-bot: autoscaler forecast: gpu-pool-2 -> 95% at 2026-03-18T10:00:00Z (trend=+12%/hr). Suggest reserve +1 node for canary window.

Marta: Updated owners: zhou(schema), alex(dashboard), sara(smoke tests), kevin(infra). Please ack and paste any blockers.

Alex: Ack. Dashboard SQL (example query) below — uses token_event -> join with cost_estimates; buckets by route. Let me know if the schema fields change.

```sql
SELECT route, sum(tokens) AS tokens, sum(estimated_cost) AS est_cost,
       approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) AS p95
FROM token_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN now() - interval '1 day' AND now()
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY est_cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Zhou: Note: PR 452 renames `token_count` -> `tokens`. If you rely on `token_count` rename in dashboards, update aliasing or I'll add a compatibility view.

Alex: Please add a compatibility view, easier for quick rollouts. I can update queries later.

Sara: Smoke plan: 3 canary runs (1k, 10k, 50k tokens) across three tenants, measure token-accuracy, token-cost delta, P95. Thresholds: cost regression <= 2%, p95 delta <= 5%. If fail -> rollback.

Marta: Sounds good. Can someone drop the canary dataset in /shared/canaries/token-attr/50k.csv? Alex, can your dashboard point there for test runs?

Alex: Will point it. Also adding a temporary per-route filter to compare old vs new attribution.

Kevin: I'll reserve +1 node in gpu-pool-2 for the canary window and watch autoscaler. If traffic spikes, I'll trigger the fallback routing to model-quantized variant.

deploy-bot: scheduled: rollforward window set to 2026-03-18 09:00 PT. Auto-rollback if token-cost regression > 3% or p95 increase > 8% across canary tenants.

Marta: Great — last ask: code owners, please review PR 452 and 460 (batcher change) by EOD today so we can schedule. Tag me if blocked. :thumbsup:

Zhou: Reviewing now, will ping with comments.

Alex: Reviewing dashboard PRs, minor tweaks.

Sara: Running the 1k token smoke now, posting logs shortly.

Marta: Thanks all. I'll create the rollout calendar invite once the PRs are merged.
